questions.q: What existential question did John see on the menu at The Why Café?
questions.why: The menu listed three questions, one of which is "Why are you here?".

questions.q: Why does the author warn against materialism in advertising?
questions.why: The text says advertisers promise happiness by buying more.

questions.q: Which example illustrates how a mechanic finds purpose?
questions.why: The text mentions a mechanic's satisfaction from fixing cars.

questions.q: What role do friends and family play in finding purpose?
questions.why: The text notes people around us affect our development.

questions.q: According to the book, what is the key to living happily?
questions.why: The book states to pursue what makes you happy.
